historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Clarifies manual classification and prevents OS evidence from replacing authoritative early-boot screens.

original_test_intent: Verify POST memory mode, total size and speed and the BIOS Memory Configuration size against the approved DIMM specification.
original_method: Qualified operator or KVM powers on, captures the transient POST fields, enters the specified BIOS path without changing settings, captures the page and performs a field-level specification comparison; OS data is corroboration only.
manual_activity: Operator/KVM performs power-on, transient POST capture, F2 entry and BIOS Memory Configuration capture; agent may organize evidence and optional post-boot logs.
required_inputs: Approved DIMM/board/CPU/BIOS specification with expected mode/total size/speed
Qualified operator or KVM and safe power-on access
Capture method able to preserve transient POST
SEL/ECC/thermal abort, no-save exit and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Verify physical SUT identity and stable power/cooling
Use qualified operator/KVM for power and BIOS interaction
Exit BIOS without saving any unintended change
Stop on no-POST, ECC/SEL/thermal warning or instability
No automatic reboot, memory/BIOS modification or recovery
agent_execution_scope: Accept and index operator screen captures, compare named fields to supplied spec and optionally collect post-boot read-only logs
Preserve distinction between POST and BIOS observations
Do not claim screen visibility, substitute OS data, operate physical controls or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide expected mode/size/speed and acceptable display interpretation
Ensure qualified capture and resolve POST/BIOS discrepancies

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly identifies no agent command for the authoritative visual steps; post-boot dmesg is corroborative only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Manual KVM/console capture of POST and specified BIOS page; optional secure read-only DMI/dmesg after boot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: POST mode/size/speed, F2 BIOS path, DIMM-spec comparison and1/5 fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record continuous or timestamped console evidence covering power-on, POST fields and BIOS page, then compare each field to a signed expectation table.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds traceable capture, explicit no-save boundary, health aborts and evidence ownership.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: None; OS-only evidence is explicitly insufficient for the transient POST requirement.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: POST may be brief or hidden by splash/fast boot, and displayed speed can represent configured rather than rated module speed.

project_override_considerations: Project must define expected display labels/units and whether POST and BIOS speeds are rated, configured or effective; evidence cannot be inferred from Linux alone.
expected_evidence: Board/CPU/DIMM/BIOS/firmware identifiers and signed expected fields
POST captures showing memory mode, total size and speed
BIOS Memory Configuration capture and navigation context
No-save exit/final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The POST and BIOS steps consistently support comparison with the DIMM specification. Exact expected values are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operator/KVM, specification and capture can be supplied; the case is manual rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Defines authoritative visual evidence and prevents an SSH/dmesg substitute from erasing POST coverage.
independent_technical_reasoning: POST memory data is emitted before an OS session exists and may include training mode or configured speed that the OS later normalizes or omits. A post-boot inventory therefore cannot prove what the firmware displayed during training. Timestamped console evidence must capture the transient state and the subsequent BIOS page as two distinct observations.
